Motion
SpinDino and egg models turn slowly on every tile (one turn every 6 s). Until the Blender models exist, the images bob 6 px and tilt ±4° every 2 s.
SunburstLight rays behind Limited and Featured items rotate once every 12 s and pulse brighter.
PulseRobux and CLAIM buttons breathe: scale 1 → 1.06 → 1 every 1.2 s. Pressing squashes to 0.94.
WiggleTags (BEST DEAL!, LIMITED, +50% MORE) rock ±5° every 2 s so the eye lands on them.
ShimmerA white shine sweeps across rare cards and the Prism Egg every 3 s; rainbow text scrolls.
Count upCash amounts (Welcome back, packs) roll up from 0 in 0.8 s with a tick sound.
Pop inPanels open from 85% to 100% with a small overshoot (0.25 s, back easing).
Colour
Green = buy / goEvery main action button. Players learn one colour means 'press me'.
Yellow & orangeWarm, high-energy colours that grab attention: titles, limited offers, power.
Red = urgentLIMITED tags, close and sell. Used sparingly so it keeps its punch.
Purple & gold = rarePremium and high-rarity items; gold tags mark the best deals.
Rainbow = specialOnly for the rarest and limited things, never for everyday buttons.
Bright on darkSaturated cards on a dark panel give strong contrast that kids read at a glance.
One rarity laddergrey → green → blue → purple → gold, the order players know from other games.
